title: Week 14 Secure Data Flow
description: Trust boundaries, protected configuration, minimized plaintext, ciphertext, audit records, and rejection paths for the Thesis Consultation Reminder System.

diagrams.title: Secure Data Flow and Trust Boundaries
diagrams.accessibility: Coordinator and adviser browsers use the Flutter public client over trusted local HTTPS. Laravel authenticates roles, creates or opens authenticated envelopes through OpenSSL, reads an ignored server keyring, stores workflow and replay receipts in MariaDB, and writes allowlisted audit metadata. Rejected invalid, altered, expired, replayed, or unauthorized requests return safe errors without plaintext.
